title: Event envelope (version 1)
description: The wrapper around every event on every topic. Consumers must IGNORE fields they do not know (additionalProperties is true on purpose): that is what lets a producer add fields without breaking anyone.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Consumers use it to recognise a duplicate delivery.

version.description: The shape of data. A consumer may refuse a version it does not know.

key.description: Id of the thing the event is about; also the Kafka message key (keeps one ride's events in order).
